1: Arrival at Bagdogra or Siliguri and transfer to Phuentsholing
Border formalities at the Bhutan Gate
Check in and the rest of the day free
2: Breakfast, then north into the hills towards Thimphu
The Chukha dam and the Wang Chhu gorge on the way
Optional: the Zorig Chusum school of arts
Arrival transfer and check in for the night
3: Breakfast, then west down the valley to Paro
Terraced fields and farmhouses the whole way
The Memorial Chorten and the Buddha Dordenma
4: Breakfast, then out into the Paro valley
The climb up the pine slope to Taktsang
The monastery wedged into the cliff face
5: Breakfast, then the long run back south
Down through the Chukha gorge to the plains
Optional: Zangto Pelri Lhakhang in the town
Arrival transfer and check in for the night
6: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Border formalities and transfer to Siliguri

expert.name: Tenzin
expert.quote: Designed around the Bagdogra and Siliguri arrival, so there is no Paro flight to buy. Five nights, two valleys.
expert.tip: Reach Phuentsholing before four in the afternoon. The immigration office at the gate closes early and queues build after lunch.

summary: 6 days through Phuentsholing, Thimphu, Paro, with 5 nights, Breakfast and dinner each day and a licensed Bhutanese guide: the thimphu sightseeing with simtokha dzong, the hike to the tiger's nest.
included: Included: 5 nights across Phuentsholing, Thimphu, Paro with Breakfast and dinner each day; all land transfers by private vehicle; the Thimphu sightseeing with Simtokha Dzong; the Hike to the Tiger's Nest; a licensed Bhutanese guide; permits and the sustainable development fee as quoted.
not_included: Not included: international and domestic flights; lunches and any meals not listed; monument entrance fees where not stated; travel insurance; personal expenses.
